messages.subject: Get new order from ColReorder in DataTables
parts:
Hi, 
I am actually using DataTables and the plugin ColReorder to set a new order in the columns shown in the table.
I would like to be able to get this new order in a variable that I can use in server.R

Does anyone know how to proceed ?

Regards

Sam

messages.author: 85e053d519f0f372
messages.subject: Re: Get new order from ColReorder in DataTables
parts:
I think you can obtain the current order via .fnOrder(), and save it
via Shiny.onInputChange(). This needs to be done in a certain event
(e.g. .on(something, callback())). Please see if you can figure out by
yourself with this example:
https://groups.google.com/forum/#!topic/shiny-discuss/px1h-VF8D64

Regards,
Yihui
